Maya: Small thread: we keep running into mixed terminology for the "pin model" feature across docs/SDKs. We need a tight rule to avoid churn in the migration PRs. Thoughts? cc @Liam @Sophia @Ravi
Liam: I propose: glossary uses noun `model pinning`. UI and short headings: verbs `Pin model` / `Unpin model`. Code keys: camelCase in JS, snake_case in YAML/config.
Sophia: Agree. Also suggest adding a one-line glossary definition and a redirect note so search finds variants.
Ravi: For the SDK snippets, let's show both variants side-by-side in a migration note: JS vs server config. That way engineers can copy the right example.
docs-bot: PR #512 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (glossary + example snippets)
Maya: Can someone paste before/after snippets for the migration guide?
Liam: Before (mixed):
```js
await client.generate({ model: 'open-llama-v1', pin_model: true });
```
After (JS):
```js
await client.generate({ model: 'open-llama-v1', pinModel: true });
```
Server YAML: keep snake_case:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: inference
    model: open-llama-v1
    pin_model: true
```
Sophia: Action items: 1) Sophia finalize glossary text + redirect alias. 2) Liam run grep and open example-only migration PR. 3) Ravi add a small grep-based docs CI lint to flag mixed forms.
Maya: Timeline: PRs by Friday. Thanks all.
